items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases
items.content:
Describe the interface you need in plain English, then let the agent build a live surface you can both use and update—so you spend less time adapting to tools and more time getting work done.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

items.creator: Kayla Cinnamon

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot 应用入门指南：如何使用画布构建自定义工作流。通过用英语描述所需界面，代理将构建一个可共同使用和更新的实时界面，减少适应工具的时间，提升工作效率。本文源自 GitHub 博客。
summaries.en: The article "GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to build custom workflows with canvases" explains how to create custom workflows using GitHub Copilot. Users describe their desired interface in plain English, and the agent generates a live, collaborative surface that can be updated together. This approach aims to reduce time spent adapting to tools, allowing more focus on completing work efficiently. The guide is intended for beginners and emphasizes simplicity and productivity. (Word count: 98)

items.title: Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app
items.content:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.

The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
How we rebuilt the diff surface in the GitHub Copilot app to open a million-line pull request with hundreds of inline review comments.
The post Rendering huge pull requests in the GitHub Copilot app appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Alberto Gimeno

summaries.zh: GitHub Copilot 官方博客发布文章《在 GitHub Copilot 应用中渲染百万行拉取请求》。文章介绍了团队如何重构 GitHub Copilot 应用中的差异界面，以支持打开包含数百条行内评论的百万行拉取请求。该优化提升了应用处理大型代码变更的能力，确保用户在查看和评论大量代码时仍能获得流畅体验。
summaries.en: The GitHub Copilot app was updated to efficiently render very large pull requests, up to a million lines with hundreds of inline comments. The team rebuilt the diff surface to handle such massive files without performance issues. This improvement allows users to review lengthy changes smoothly. The update was announced on The GitHub Blog.
